Output A orange / B black follow UBEC reference colors. CAD evidence only; physical polarity not tested.
diameter_note: Main 12V/5V supplies and returns: provisional 1.5 mm insulated OD. Local RS232 3V3/GND chain and logic/resistor connections: provisional 1.0 mm. Not selected conductor gauges.
junction_hardware: Insulated space envelopes only. Actual junction, mounting and strain relief not selected.

xt30_polarity.basis: Molded + and − marks on both embedded connector halves, visually inspected in Fusion

rs232_pad_mapping.evidence: CAD +/− marks and circular pad centers; supply is 3.3 V from ESP32. R1 follows the inferred S26/S27 signal map; CAD signal arrows differ from the supplied photo and are not electrical evidence.

enclosure_resize_v77.mapping: For the listed routes, add 0 below the lower Z limit, ramp linearly to +3 mm over the interval, and add +3 mm above the upper limit. This maps the solid envelope as well as its centreline. Resweep with actual wire diameters after routing is settled.
